description: Run one symmetric long/short scan over the same top-volume universe and return rule-independent breadth, 24h liquidity semantics and ranked directional candidates. Use this first for comprehensive day-trade or scalp discovery; then deep-dive only the shortlist with derivatives/order-flow tools. For a general scalp request use style:"scalp" and omit longRules/shortRules to use transparent RSI/EMA defaults. For explicit user filters use screener_run instead. Near misses never satisfy all rules.

limitPerSide.description: Candidates returned per direction. Default 10, max 25.

plotKey.description: Optional; defaults to the first indicator output.

studyId.description: Indicator id, e.g. rsi or ema.

right.description: Use a number for a threshold: RSI >50 is {left:{kind:"indicator",studyId:"rsi"},operator:"above",right:50}. To compare with an indicator use {kind:"operand",operand:{kind:"indicator",studyId:"ema",params:{period:20}}}.

manualSymbols.description: Optional symbols forced into the universe before current-volume ranking.

market.description: Defaults to the chart. Perpetuals are futures.

plotKey.description: Optional; defaults to the first indicator output.

studyId.description: Indicator id, e.g. rsi or ema.

right.description: Use a number for a threshold: RSI >50 is {left:{kind:"indicator",studyId:"rsi"},operator:"above",right:50}. To compare with an indicator use {kind:"operand",operand:{kind:"indicator",studyId:"ema",params:{period:20}}}.

style.description: scalp defaults to 5m; daytrade to 15m. Explicit timeframe overrides this.

timeframe.description: Default 5m for scalp, otherwise 15m; does not inherit the open chart.

name: daytrade_opportunity_scan
